title: Physics-Constrained Autoencoder for Interpretable Health Representation Learning in Turbofan Engines
abstract: arXiv:2611.14266v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Health Indices (HIs) summarize degradation from operational data and support diagnostic and prognostic tasks in Prognostics and Health Management (PHM). Their usefulness depends on capturing degradation and interpreting system condition. Autoencoders learn such representations from unlabelled monitoring data; however, when training is driven only by reconstruction, the physical meaning of latent variables remains undefined, limiting their interpretation and diagnostic value. This work proposes a physics-constrained autoencoder that embeds system knowledge as an inductive bias in the decoder architecture and as a learning bias in the loss function. translated_title: 面向涡扇发动机可解释健康表征学习的物理约束自编码器
translated_abstract: 健康指数用于从运行数据中总结退化情况，并支持故障预测与健康管理（PHM）中的诊断与预测任务。其有效性取决于能否捕捉退化过程并解释系统状态。自编码器可以从无标签的监测数据中学习此类表征；然而，当训练仅由重构目标驱动时，潜在变量的物理含义依然不明确，限制了其解释能力和诊断价值。本工作提出一种物理约束自编码器，将系统知识作为归纳偏置嵌入解码器架构，并作为学习偏置嵌入损失函数。解码器包含可微分物理方程，以潜在变量和运行条件作为输入，从结构上引导每个潜在变量表示预定义的物理量，从而在聚合为系统级健康指数之前实现部件级分析。该方法……
tldr: 提出一种物理约束自编码器，通过在解码器中嵌入可微分物理方程、在损失函数中引入学习偏置，使每个潜在变量对应预定义的物理量，从而实现涡扇发动机部件级可解释的健康表征学习。
en_tdlr: A physics-constrained autoencoder embeds differentiable physical equations in the decoder and learning biases in the loss function, guiding each latent variable to represent a predefined physical quantity for interpretable component-level health representation learning in turbofan engines.
